title: bardolier eject output
description: down-all, then a holder check, then diskutil eject. cli-spec.md §6 (Lifecycle / SSD). A held volume fails EJECT_BLOCKED with the same holder records in error.details.holders — it is never forced. Additive changes only once the app ships (Phase 5+).

volume.description: The mount point that was ejected, e.g. /Volumes/ssd.

stopped.description: Projects down-all stopped on the way, sorted.

holders.description: Always empty on success; populated in error.details.holders on EJECT_BLOCKED.

docker_stopped.description: True when the Docker engine was stopped to release the volume (eject --stop-docker, or a confirmed prompt). Additive and NOT required: an app build from before it decodes the same payload.

root.description: The configured root's name that was ejected. Additive since phase 18.

holder.description: A process holding files open on the SSD, as lsof reports it. Rendered by the app on EJECT_BLOCKED (app-spec.md §10).

paths.description: Paths under the volume it holds — enough to recognise, not a file listing.
